answer: Commit a hash of the work receipt first, reveal the payload one epoch later, and stamp each reveal with a nonce that has never appeared on the ledger. The naive design trusts a submitted name; this one trusts the delta between commit and reveal, so a copy has nothing to open later. Weight tracks independent path length, which stops one payer from fanning accounts out of a single ember. A raven pass over the log flags any nonce seen twice, so a thousand clones cost a thousand reveals.
